statements.label: main (Theorem 1)
statements.restatement: For every x in X with P c(x) >= 0 and contacts containing {1,2,3,7,11,12}, Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 for all O in O(4). Degenerate spectra (collisions) and extra contacts are reduced to Appendix B / one-circle theorem and to earlier six-sets; the curve argument is run on eight-distinct, exactly-six-contact configurations.

statements.label: Lemma 2
statements.restatement: If m(tau) = f(tau) kappa + v(tau) in Sing C with f divergent and v holomorphic at 0, then H_kappa v(0) = 0; if -eta Im P v(0) >= 0 then its Leibniz sum is >= 0 on O(4).

statements.label: Lemma 3
statements.restatement: An eight-distinct counterexample with exactly these six contacts can be perturbed (Rouche on H11 - h) to one with generic real (r,s,u,h), keeping strict gaps and Phi_O < 0.
